newsitem.title: EGYPT: Amriyah Cement profit up in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Amriyah Cement profit up in 95/96.

text.p: Amriyah Cement said on Saturday that profit available for distribution was 157.3 million pounds in the financial year 1995/96, up from 133.7 million pounds in the previous year. The years end on June 30.
Shareholders' rights were worth 312 million pounds, compared with 252 million one year earlier, the company balance sheet published in al-Ahram newspaper showed.
Shareholders' portion of the profit was 105 million pounds - up from 90 million pounds in 1994/5 - or 5.25 pounds for every 20 million shares in 1995/96.
The company has a tax exemption until 1998.
Net sales for 1995/96 were 374 million pounds, compared with 360 million pounds in 1994/95. Production was 2,335 million tonnes in the year, the statement said.
